authority_boundary: This compilation validates and summarizes Council records. It does not approve, merge, activate, ratify, or certify.
conditions: Bind WP00 to one exact content-addressed formal object and manifest; the categorical model, mechanized theorem, checker, executable demonstration, quality and refinement definitions, fixtures, and trust-boundary statement must all refer to that object.

Enumerate the fixed trust kernel. The checker, certificate semantics or interpreter, admission policy, artifact-identity rules, and evaluation-context binding may not be modified through the same replacement gate they validate.
State exact typed laws and assumptions for Prog/run/quotation adequacy, Later/next/gfix, semantic refinement, operational quality Q, and compatibility with composition, currying, and evaluation.

Make checker soundness, evaluation-context integrity, certificate validity, and any decidability, termination, or resource assumptions explicit in the mechanized preservation theorem; do not promote bounded results to claims of self-verification or unbounded intelligence growth.

Demonstrate at least one bounded capability-extension transition and one semantics-preserving optimization, plus fail-closed adversarial fixtures covering malformed and stale proposals, unsafe or non-refining candidates, non-improvement, metric or context substitution, trust-kernel mutation attempts, and resource exhaustion.
Use a smallest-complete-model milestone and explicit stop or narrow criteria before any scope expansion or production-oriented implementation.
